```{r titan_breakpoints_setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("scripts", "00_source.R"))

library(TITAN2)

set.seed(1337)  # for reproducibility
```

```{r 06_titan_breakpoints_chunk_01}

# 1) Filter out controls and unwanted sites
otus <- zotu_df %>%
  #filter controls
  filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "control")) %>%
  #filter hakalau so every sample that starts with "H" or "CH"
  filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "H|CH")) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% meta_data$sample_id)

#calculate READS for the whole data set
sum_reads <- sum(otus %>% select(starts_with("zotu")))

#calculate MEAN READS with SE for the whole data set
mean_reads <- mean(rowSums(otus %>% select(starts_with("zotu"))))

#calculate SE reads for the whole data set
se_reads <- sd(rowSums(otus %>% select(starts_with("zotu")))) / sqrt(nrow(otus))

# merge otu table with taxonomy df
#calculate the 3 most abundant arthropod orders of the data set
# and give the relative abundance for the top 3 orders
taxa_summary <- otus %>%
  select(starts_with("zotu")) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "zotu", values_to = "abundance") %>%
  left_join(taxonomy_df %>%
              select(zotu_id, phylum, class, order) |>
              drop_na(order) |>
              #tolower for everything in zotu_id
              mutate(zotu_id = tolower(zotu_id)),
            by = c("zotu" = "zotu_id")) %>%
  group_by(order) %>%
  summarise(total_abundance = sum(abundance)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_abundance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) |>
  mutate(total_read = 1098901) |>
  group_by(order) |>
  summarise(relative_abundance = (total_abundance / total_read) * 100)



# 2) Build species matrix and gradient
sp_mat <- otus %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id") %>%
  select(starts_with("zotu")) %>%
  as.matrix()

elev <- meta_data %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% rownames(sp_mat)) %>%
  arrange(match(sample_id, rownames(sp_mat))) %>%
  pull(elevation_m)

#calculate samples per ridge
samples_per_ridge <- meta_data %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% rownames(sp_mat)) %>%
  group_by(sample_site) %>%
  summarise(n = n())

#calculate mean species richness from meta_data
#omit all controls, hakalau and samples that are not in sp_mat, but also
#KT1 and KA5
mean_richness <- meta_data %>%
  filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "control")) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(sample_id, "H|CH")) %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% rownames(sp_mat)) %>%
  filter(!sample_id %in% c("KT1", "KA5")) %>%
  summarise(mean_richness = mean(richness), se_richness = sd(richness) / sqrt(n()))


# Ensure alignment & no NAs in gradient
stopifnot(identical(rownames(sp_mat), meta_data %>%
                    filter(sample_id %in% rownames(sp_mat)) %>%
                    arrange(match(sample_id, rownames(sp_mat))) %>% pull(sample_id)))
ok <- !is.na(elev)
sp_mat <- sp_mat[ok, , drop = FALSE]
elev   <- elev[ok]

# Quick diagnostics
cat("N samples:", nrow(sp_mat), " | N taxa (pre-filter):", ncol(sp_mat), "\n")
summary(elev)


```

```{r 06_titan_breakpoints_chunk_02, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

occ <- colSums(sp_mat > 0)
keep <- names(occ)[occ >= 3]

cat("N taxa kept (occ >= 3):", length(keep), "\n")
stopifnot(length(keep) >= 10)  # avoid fragile runs

sp_mat_filt <- sp_mat[, keep]
sp_mat_filt_pa <- (sp_mat_filt > 0) * 1

# run with bootstrap for reliability
titan_out <- titan(
  elev,         # your gradient vector
  sp_mat_filt,         # your site × taxon matrix
  minSplt = 5,
  numPerm = 250,
  boot = TRUE,
  nBoot = 500,
  imax = TRUE,
  ivTot = FALSE,
  pur.cut = 0.95,
  rel.cut = 0.95,
  ncpus = 1,
  memory = FALSE,
  messaging = TRUE
)

```

```{r 06_titan_breakpoints_chunk_03}

# define your true limits
min_e <- min(elev, na.rm=TRUE)
max_e <- max(elev, na.rm=TRUE)


# 1) Grab your summary table
sumz_df <- titan_out$sumz.cp %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("group") %>%
  pivot_longer(-group, names_to="q", values_to="elev") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=q, values_from=elev) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(`0.05`,`0.50`,`0.95`),
           ~ pmin(pmax(.x, min_e), max_e)),
    median = `0.50`,
    lower  = `0.05`,
    upper  = `0.95`
  )

# Show sampling density along the gradient (context for CPs)
ggplot(data.frame(elev = elev), aes(elev)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  labs(x = "Elevation (m)", y = "Samples", title = "Sampling density along elevation")

# 2) Plot
ggplot(sumz_df, aes(x=group, y=median, ymin=lower, ymax=upper)) +
  geom_pointrange() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x=NULL, y="Elevation (m)",
       title="TITAN community thresholds (capped to data range)")
```

```{r 06_titan_breakpoints_chunk_04}
# 1) Combine your replicate matrices
bs_unf <- as.data.frame(titan_out$maxSumz) %>% setNames(c("sumz-","sumz+"))
bs_flt <- as.data.frame(titan_out$maxFsumz) %>% setNames(c("fsumz-","fsumz+"))

bs <- bind_rows(
  bs_unf  %>% mutate(type="Unfiltered"),
  bs_flt  %>% mutate(type="Filtered")
) %>%
  pivot_longer(-type, names_to="group", values_to="elev")

bs$type <- factor(bs$type, levels = c("Unfiltered", "Filtered"))


# 2) Plot
ggplot(bs, aes(x=group, y=elev, fill=type)) +
  geom_violin(trim=FALSE, alpha=0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width=0.1, outlier.size=0.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Elevation (m)",
    fill = NULL,
    title = "Bootstrap distributions of community change‐points"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

cp_main <- median(bs_unf$`sumz+`, na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r 06_titan_breakpoints_chunk_05}
# Re-use bs from above
bootstrap_plot_ridge <-
ggplot(bs, aes(x=elev, y=group, fill=type)) +
  ggridges::geom_density_ridges(alpha=0.6, scale=1.2, rel_min_height=0.01) +
  # vertical line at main CP
  geom_vline(xintercept = cp_main, linetype = 2, color = "black", size = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = "Elevation (m)",
    y = "TITAN statistic",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  ggsci::scale_fill_simpsons() +
  theme_minimal()

bootstrap_plot_ridge

save_fig(
  tag = "S10_titan_bootstrap_distributions",
  plot = bootstrap_plot_ridge,
  which = "supp",
  prefix = "none",
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)
```

```{r 06_titan_breakpoints_chunk_10, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# --- Run a presence/absence (PA) TITAN as a robustness check ---
titan_pa <- titan(
  elev,                 # the gradient vector (elevation in meters), one value per sample
  sp_mat_filt_pa,       # site × taxon matrix in PRESENCE/ABSENCE (0/1) form
  minSplt = 5,          # minimum number of samples allowed on either side of a split
  numPerm = 250,        # permutations to assess significance (community-level tests)
  boot = TRUE,          # do bootstrap resampling to get CP uncertainty
  nBoot = 500,          # number of bootstrap replicates
  imax = TRUE,          # use the location of maximum aggregated z (sum of z) as community CP
  ivTot = FALSE,        # don't compute total indicator value (saves time/memory)
  pur.cut = 0.95,       # purity cutoff (taxon direction consistency across bootstraps)
  rel.cut = 0.95,       # reliability cutoff (taxon occurrence/response strength)
  ncpus = 1,            # CPUs to use (1 = serial; raise if you want parallel)
  memory = FALSE,       # set TRUE only if memory becomes a constraint (slower but safer)
  messaging = TRUE      # print progress messages
)

# --- Get the community-level change point (CP) for PA run ---
# titan_pa$maxSumz holds bootstrap CPs for community "sumz" (aggregated positive vs negative z).
# Columns are the two directions: decreasing assemblage ("sumz-") and increasing assemblage ("sumz+").
# We convert to a data.frame and name the columns explicitly:
bs_unf_pa <- as.data.frame(titan_pa$maxSumz) %>% setNames(c("sumz-","sumz+"))

# Take the median CP across bootstrap replicates for the increasing assemblage ("sumz+").
# This is the point along elevation where the community most strongly *increases*.
cp_pa <- median(bs_unf_pa$`sumz+`, na.rm = TRUE)

# Print a quick comparison line (will work once cp_main exists; see below).
cat("Community CP (abundance):", round(cp_main,1), "m | (PA):", round(cp_pa,1), "m\n")


# --- Repeat the same extraction for your main (abundance) TITAN run ---
# titan_out$maxSumz is the abundance-based bootstrap CPs (same structure as above).
ms <- as.data.frame(titan_out$maxSumz); names(ms) <- c("sumz-","sumz+")
cp_main <- median(ms$`sumz+`, na.rm = TRUE)   # median CP (increasing assemblage) under abundance


# --- (Again) extract CP for the PA run in the same way (functionally identical to above) ---
# This block duplicates the earlier PA extraction; it’s fine, just redundant.
ms_pa <- as.data.frame(titan_pa$maxSumz); names(ms_pa) <- c("sumz-","sumz+")
cp_pa <- median(ms_pa$`sumz+`, na.rm = TRUE)

# Final print: abundance vs PA community CPs side-by-side.
cat("Community CP (abundance):", round(cp_main,1), "m | (PA):", round(cp_pa,1), "m\n")

```

```{r 06_titan_breakpoints_chunk_11}
status <- read.csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv")) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  dplyr::rename(zotu_id = upid) |>
  filter(str_detect(zotu_id, "Zotu")) |>
  select(zotu_id, status_final = final_status, status_ni = predict)


# assuming you have classification_df with zotu → status ("native","introduced")
df_plot <- as.data.frame(titan_out$sppmax) %>%
  rownames_to_column("zotu_id") %>%
  filter(filter > 0) %>%
  left_join(status |>
              mutate(zotu_id = tolower(zotu_id)), by = "zotu_id") %>%
  transmute(
    zotu_id,
    threshold = `50%`,
    zscore    = zscore,
    direction = if_else(maxgrp == 2, "increase", "decline"),   # z+ vs z-%>%
    status = status_ni) |>
  left_join(taxonomy_df |>
              mutate(zotu_id = tolower(zotu_id)), by = "zotu_id") |>
  arrange(threshold)

```

```{r 06_titan_breakpoints_chunk_12}

# ── axes & CI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_min <- 4; y_max <- 6
ci_lo <- 400; ci_hi <- 670

# host colors (tree species)
host_cols <- c("ohia" = "#8B0000", "guava" = "goldenrod2")

# facet labels you already built
lab_counts <- df_plot |>
  dplyr::count(direction) |>
  dplyr::mutate(lab = paste0(direction, " (n=", n, ")"))
lab_map <- setNames(lab_counts$lab, lab_counts$direction)


#curves
# ---- HOST DENSITY CURVES FROM ANCHORS (no Gaussian) ----
elev_seq <- seq(300, 750, by = 5)

# Strawberry guava: 75% at 300 m → <10% at 600 m → 0% at ≥650 m
anchors_guava <- tibble(
  elevation = c(300, 600, 650, 750),
  density   = c(0.75, 0.09, 0.00, 0.00)
)

# ʻŌhiʻa: low at 300 m, peak 85% at 620 m, stay high and NOT falling at 750 m (90%)
anchors_ohia <- tibble(
  elevation = c(300, 500, 620, 750),
  density   = c(0.20, 0.55, 0.85, 0.90)
)

# Monotone interpolation (prevents overshoot) + cap to [0, 0.95]
interp_host <- function(anchors, grid) {
  f <- splinefun(anchors$elevation, anchors$density, method = "monoH.FC")
  dens <- pmin(pmax(f(grid), 0), 0.95)
  tibble(elevation = grid, density = dens)
}

ohia_curve  <- interp_host(anchors_ohia, elev_seq)  |> mutate(host = "ohia")
guava_curve <- interp_host(anchors_guava, elev_seq) |> mutate(host = "guava")

host_density <- bind_rows(ohia_curve, guava_curve)

# Map density (0–0.95) onto the z-score axis (4–6) for plotting background
host_density <- host_density %>%
  mutate(y_bg = y_min + density * (y_max - y_min))

# ── icons at curve start/end ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# assumes your host_density has columns: elevation, host ∈ {ohia, guava}, y_bg
icon_paths <- c("ohia" = data_path("images/ohia.png"),
                "guava"= data_path("images/sberry.png")
                )

icon_df <- rbind(
  host_density |>
    dplyr::group_by(host) |>
    dplyr::slice_min(elevation, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(img = icon_paths[host],
                  x = elevation - 10,            # slight left pad
                  y = y_bg + 0.06),              # nudge above curve
  host_density |>
    dplyr::group_by(host) |>
    dplyr::slice_max(elevation, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(img = icon_paths[host],
                  x = elevation + 10,            # slight right pad
                  y = y_bg + 0.06)
)

# ── plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p <- ggplot() +
  # CI as two thick lines + reference at 500 m
  geom_vline(xintercept = ci_lo, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 1.2, alpha = .95) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = ci_hi, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 1.2, alpha = .95) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 500,  linetype = 2,      linewidth = 0.5, alpha = .7) +

  # background areas strictly under each density line
  geom_ribbon(
    data = host_density,
    aes(x = elevation, ymin = y_min, ymax = y_bg, fill = host, group = host),
    alpha = 0.10, colour = NA, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # density outlines (we'll show THESE in the legend)
  geom_line(
    data = host_density,
    aes(x = elevation, y = y_bg, colour = host, group = host),
    linewidth = 1.05, alpha = 0.95, show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = host_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = host_cols,
    breaks = c("ohia","guava"),
    labels = c("ʻōhiʻa", "Strawberry guava"),
    name   = "Tree species density (approx.)",
    guide  = guide_legend(order = 3, override.aes = list(linetype = 1, linewidth = 1.4))
  ) +

  # PNG icons at curve ends
  ggimage::geom_image(
    data = icon_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y, image = img),
    size = 0.12, asp = 1, by = "width", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # NEW fill scale for NIClassify status (to match your legend mock)
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +

  # TITAN points + labels
  geom_point(
    data = df_plot,
    aes(x = threshold, y = zscore, shape = direction, fill = status),
    size = 4, alpha = 0.95, colour = "black", stroke = 0.25
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_plot,
    aes(x = threshold, y = zscore, label = stringr::str_to_title(order)),
    size = 2.5, min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = .35, seed = 1, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # legends to mirror your mock
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("introduced"="firebrick", "native"="#377EB8"),
    breaks = c("introduced", "native"),
    name   = "NIClassify status",
    guide  = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 5, colour = NA, stroke = 0)  # ← no outline
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("decline" = 25, "increase" = 24),  # down / up triangles
    breaks = c("decline","increase"),
    name   = "Distribution changes",
    guide  = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(size = 5, fill = "grey85", colour = NA, stroke = 0)  # ← no outline
    )
  )  +

  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(300, 750), ylim = c(y_min, y_max), expand = TRUE) +
  labs(x = "Elevation breakpoint (m)", y = "z-score") +
  facet_wrap(~ direction, ncol = 1, labeller = as_labeller(lab_map)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.box       = "vertical",
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 11)
  ) +
  # right axis back-calculated to %
  scale_y_continuous(
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (.-y_min)/(y_max - y_min) * 100,
                        name = "Tree species density (%)")
  )

p

save_fig(
  tag = "F6_titan2",
  plot = p,
  which = "main",
  prefix = "none",
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)

```
